cases.given: User status is supported and no status is set
cases.expected: Displayed status is empty and the picker is hidden
androidMethods: initial state - no status set

cases.given: The status picker is hidden
cases.expected: The picker transitions to the predefined status selection state
androidMethods: Open event transitions to ShowingPicker

cases.given: The status picker is open with an existing status unchanged
cases.expected: The picker closes without changing the status
androidMethods: Dismiss event from ShowingPicker goes back to Hidden

cases.given: A predefined status is selected and the SDK accepts it
cases.expected: The picker closes and the new user-set status becomes displayed
androidMethods: Set event calls setUserStatus and transitions to Hidden with updated status

cases.given: An existing status is visible and the SDK rejects an update
cases.expected: The update reports failure and does not display the rejected value
androidMethods: Set event failure surfaces a Failure action

cases.given: No status exists
cases.expected: Custom input opens with default emoji and empty text
androidMethods: OpenCustomInput with no existing status uses defaults

cases.given: A user-set status already exists
cases.expected: Custom input is prefilled from the existing status
androidMethods: OpenCustomInput with existing rawStatus pre-fills values

cases.given: A saved status exists and a custom draft is open
cases.expected: The draft closes without clearing the saved status
androidMethods: CancelCustomInput goes back to Hidden

cases.given: A user-set status is displayed
cases.expected: The picker closes and displayed status becomes empty
androidMethods: Clear event calls clearUserStatus and clears displayed status

present - validate media scans the media source

cases.expected: Validation state accounts for every source
